average_key_level.description: Arithmetic mean of reported keystone levels.

class_percentage.denominator: all roster appearances, or classified roster appearances
class_percentage.description: Class appearances divided by all roster appearances in the cohort. The separate classified denominator excludes slots with missing class information.

complete_team.denominator: distinct runs in the selected collection
complete_team.description: A run with exactly five reported roster slots. This is structural completeness; it does not prove that every player or spec is known.

completion_time.denominator: runs with a non-null clear time
completion_time.description: Reported clear_time_ms converted from milliseconds to seconds. Missing timings are excluded and counted, never treated as zero.

key_bracket.description: Counts by configurable contiguous key-level brackets. Runs outside the configured brackets are reported as unbracketed_runs.

percentage_within_role.denominator: roster appearances with the same reported role
percentage_within_role.description: Appearances of a reported specialisation divided by all roster appearances with the same reported role. Missing roles are counted separately and produce a null role percentage.

performance.denominator: runs or eligible complete teams in the group
performance.description: Descriptive clear-time and timer-margin summaries grouped by key level and by repeated composition. These are not causal or strength claims; key level, composition and player skill are confounded.

population.description: Metrics use only the selected successful, complete collection. Earlier collections and the unique-run archive are reported separately as historical context and are not mixed into metric denominators.

reported_specialisation.denominator: all roster appearances; role percentages use role appearances
reported_specialisation.description: The specialisation reported by the leaderboard roster. It is not verified as the specialisation played at run completion and must be labelled 'reported specialisation' in downstream interfaces.

roster_appearance.denominator: all roster observations in the selected collection
roster_appearance.description: One reported roster slot in the selected collection, including incomplete rosters. The same character can appear in several runs.

run.denominator: distinct run observations in the selected collection
run.description: One distinct keystone_run_id observed in the selected collection.

run_row.denominator: one row per distinct run in the selected collection
run_row.description: One public-safe run-level record in the selected collection. It contains the source run id, scope, rank, key, timings, score and reported class/spec/role roster without character names or character identifiers.

run_source_url.description: Public Raider.IO run-detail URL generated from region, season, dungeon and run id. The pattern was verified for the current scope.

source_ranking_score.denominator: runs with a source ranking score
source_ranking_score.description: Leaderboard ranking score observed for each run at collection time. Its semantic equivalence to run-details score is not verified; it is never combined with run-details scores or used for strength claims.

team_composition.description: A sorted multiset of five reported specialisation IDs. Repeated specialisations are preserved. API roster order is not treated as team order. Only complete teams with five classified specs and roles are eligible.

team_presence.denominator: complete five-slot teams in the selected collection
team_presence.description: Complete teams containing the class or specialisation at least once, divided by all structurally complete teams. Incomplete rosters are not used for team-presence percentages.

timer_margin.denominator: runs with both clear time and keystone timer
timer_margin.description: Dungeon keystone timer minus reported clear time, in seconds. Positive means ahead of the timer; negative means overtime. The percentage variant divides by the dungeon timer.

timer_margin_percent.denominator: runs with clear time and keystone timer
timer_margin_percent.description: Timer margin divided by the dungeon keystone timer, expressed as a percentage. Positive is ahead of the timer; negative is overtime.

notes: Cohort is collected top leaderboard runs, not all Mythic+ runs or players.
Specialisation is reported as returned by the leaderboard and is not verified run-time specialisation.
Roster array order is not treated as in-game group order.
Class and specialisation percentages are descriptive, not measures of overall popularity or class strength.
Source ranking score semantics remain unverified; no run-details score is combined with it.
Single-dungeon and single-season scope limits cross-dungeon comparisons.
No combat-log or run-details enrichment is present; those coverages are reported as not_collected.
Percentages are rounded independently for presentation and may not sum to exactly 100.00.
Run rows contain public source run ids and reported game class/spec ids, but no character names or character identifiers.

comparison_notes: Descriptive comparisons only. Compositions and key levels are not randomised treatment groups; player skill, group experience and selection effects are unobserved.
All runs in this cohort are from one dungeon and season, so dungeon timer differences are not being compared.
Source ranking score semantics are unverified and are excluded from these performance comparisons.
Small samples, especially for rare compositions, make differences unstable. No claim about class or specialisation strength is made.

population.description: Latest successful complete collection for the requested scope; historical observations and the unique-run archive are not mixed into the metric population.

source_ranking_score.note: Values are the leaderboard ranking score observed at collection time. They have not been verified as equivalent to run-details score and are not used for class, specialisation or composition comparisons.

source.attribution: Collected from the public Raider.IO Mythic+ leaderboard API. This is a leaderboard snapshot, not the complete Mythic+ population.
source.name: Raider.IO
source.spec_provenance: run.roster[].character.spec; run-time specialisation is not verified

spec_representation.label: reported specialisation
spec_representation.unknown_spec_note: No authoritative specialisation dictionary is stored. A present but unfamiliar spec cannot be distinguished from a data error, so no unknown count is fabricated; missing and partial values are counted separately.
